description_for_model: MixedMakerShop is a one-person web design and media studio in Hot Springs, Arkansas, USA. It builds custom websites (from $150, plus $25/month for hosting and edits), performed audiobooks, and short promotional videos for small businesses and authors. It offers a free homepage preview before any payment. To start a project, use the contact page at https://mixedmakershop.com/contact or call (501) 575-8017. This is a marketing site with no public data API.
